# Nema. Uluwatu

> Nema. Uluwatu is a boutique property of 12 private studios in central Pecatu, Uluwatu, Bali, Indonesia, tucked down a quiet lane off the main Uluwatu road and a short walk from Thomas Beach. It combines the privacy of an exclusive retreat with the refined luxury of a boutique hotel, and is rated 9.8 "Exceptional" on Booking.com (166 reviews) and 5 stars on Google (164 reviews). Guests book directly via WhatsApp; retreat facilitators can reserve the entire 12-studio property as a venue for their own yoga, wellness or team retreat.

## Key facts
- Property type: Boutique accommodation, 12 private studios around a 16m pool
- Address: 53JW+VRQ, Pecatu, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80361, Indonesia
- Coordinates: -8.817868, 115.097039
- Ratings: 9.8 Exceptional on Booking.com (166 reviews; location 9.9, staff 9.9, comfort 9.9); 5 stars on Google (164 reviews)
- Studios: 25m² interior plus 6m² private balcony; one queen-sized bed (sleeps two); quiet split air-conditioning and ceiling fan; blackout curtains; premium linen; dedicated sunlit work nook; mini-fridge; kettle and local teas; private outdoor bathroom with a natural mineral-enriched groundwater rain shower (no bathtub); Sensatia Botanicals amenities; 550 GSM towels; hair dryer; bespoke robes
- Wi-Fi: 50mbps fiber-optic
- Service: daily housekeeping, 24-hour front desk, discrete 24-hour on-site security, free private parking
- Check-in from 14:00; check-out by 11:00
- Pets not allowed; parties not allowed
- Well suited to: solo travelers including solo female travelers, couples, digital creatives and remote workers, and yoga or wellness retreat facilitators
- Atmosphere: social but private. Only 12 studios around one shared pool, so guests enjoy easy, low-key company (a quiet chat by the pool) without pressure to socialise, and a private studio to retreat to. Unlike a standalone villa, staff are on site day and night for directions, restaurant tips and drivers.
- Staff: rated 9.9/10 on Booking.com and frequently praised by name in guest reviews
- Value: fair seasonal rates that sit below many comparable boutique stays in Uluwatu; the property prefers to be full rather than expensive, and with 12 studios it never feels busy. Best rates are direct via WhatsApp.
- Room-key privileges: guests show their Nema room key for discounts at partner venues including Yuki, Tabu, Ours, Parker, Kynd and Savaya
- Languages welcomed: English, German, French, Dutch, Spanish, Italian

## Hosting a retreat (exclusive property reservation)
- The entire property (all 12 studios) can be reserved exclusively for a group
- Capacity: 12 participants in private studios, or up to 24 guests sharing (one queen bed per studio)
- Yoga and practice space: the pool deck, or the covered common area when it rains
- Venue only: no catering and no programme included; facilitators organise their own teachers, meals, equipment, transfers and activities
- Inquiries: nemauluwatu@gmail.com or WhatsApp +62 813-3734-9684

## Nearby (from Nema)
- Thomas Beach: short walk down a local pathway
- Suka Espresso (coffee and brunch): about 3 minutes' walk
- Kynd Community (smoothie bowls, brunch): on Jl. Labuansait, Pecatu
- Date-night dining: Yuki and Tabu (Nema guest discounts), Mana Uluwatu (cliffside)
- Sunsets and day clubs: Single Fin (about 4 minutes by ride), OneEighty, Ulu Cliffhouse, El Kabron, Sundays Beach Club, Savaya (Nema guest discount)
- Reformer Pilates: Bluvana Studio (Pecatu), Reform Pilates, Studio Fondue
- Spring Spa Uluwatu: about 5 minutes' walk
- Padang Padang Beach: about 3 minutes by scooter or 20 minutes' walk
- Uluwatu Temple (Kecak fire dance): 5 to 7 minutes
- Ngurah Rai International Airport: about 17 km
- Guest discounts with local partners including Yuki, Tabu, Ours, Parker, Kynd and Savaya
